summary.engineering_diagnosis_delta_from_stage0b: The prior attempt (stage0bcde) diagnosed memory as the blocking resource (uncontrolled tuple/string retention growing to 1.7-4.9 GB while still climbing, terminated manually after 9-13 minutes on the executor's own judgment). This attempt replaced the dedup keys (canonical string, numeric fingerprint) with fixed-size deterministic 64-bit hashes instead of the raw string/float-tuple objects -- validated to produce IDENTICAL enumerated-form counts to the original engine on every case small enough for the original engine to complete (see command.txt step 3; largest validated case: 427,569 forms, exact match after fixing a real -0.0-vs-0.0 repr bug found during that validation). This DID substantially raise the memory ceiling reachable within a given wall-clock budget (three of four targets never exceeded 8 GB even after 100 minutes; only INV-8 approached the 13 GB external cap). But wall-clock, not memory, was the binding constraint in EVERY one of the four targets this time: none of the four ever wrote a between-level checkpoint, meaning each spent its ENTIRE ~100-minute allotment stuck inside the construction of a single complexity level (almost certainly the last, largest level, level 9 for the 6-leaf packs or level 9-10 for degree_table) without finishing it -- consistent with an estimated 10-100 million total candidate-registration attempts at that level for the 6-leaf packs, each requiring a recursive canonicalize + a 32-point numeric-fingerprint evaluation in pure Python, at an amortized cost that makes finishing within any single-session wall-clock budget implausible without either (a) a substantially larger time budget (multiple hours to a day, not attempted here), (b) a compiled/vectorized reimplementation of canonicalize/numeric_fingerprint (out of this task's scope: would be a genuinely different implementation, not merely a different enumeration STRATEGY over the same grammar), or (c) the targeted-minimality-proof alternative described in the task brief (NOT attempted in this run; would be a methodologically distinct claim from blind enumeration and is not substituted for it here).
